author: TMRX
description: Configure a product from the Price List catalog, generate a customer quote, push parts to a Work Order, or start a Rental.
versionDescription: Restored the Rental tab's by-week rate calculation, which had been missing from the recovered v3.11.1 base. Weekly Rate now auto-fills the moment both Start/Return dates are picked, using the universal tiered schedule (same for Newton and ACE): €8,000/week for the first 3 weeks, then €19,500/month (€4,875/week) from week 4 on — a deliberate cliff, not a blend, so a 4-week rental costs less than 3 weeks. Recalculates automatically whenever either date changes; still an editable field for the rare negotiated exception. Verified against the full reference schedule (weeks 1-16) before publishing — every value matches exactly.
